author: JollyGoli07
quote: GTA is meant to be GTA. If I wanted to play a relationship sim, I'd go and buy one. This game is full of bugs and glitches, the storyline is boring, and it holds you back from doing things that used to be part of the fun, because it's so focused on being politically correct. I'm much happier with GTA IV and GTA V. Both have great storylines and graphics that suit their era.
